title: Qiagen RNEasy PowerMicrobiome RNA Extraction Protocol
author: Michael Dan Siemon
materials: Qiagen RNEasy PowerMicrobiome RNA extraction kit

steps.title: Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Concentrate the wastewater sample to obtain a pellet.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix wastewater sample.
Aliquot 40 mL into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 4500 x g for 20 min.
Decant supernatant (assume 280 µl pellet).

steps.title: Prepare Sample Tube
steps.instruction: Prepare the PowerBead Bead Tube (Glass 0.1 mm) with reagents and sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl phenol–chloroform–isoamyl alcohol to the tube.
Place 0.25 g stool or biosolid sample into the tube.
Add 650 µl PM1 and 6.5 µl β-mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Perform Bead-Beating
steps.instruction: Use bead-beating as a substitute for vortexing.

substeps.instruction: Conduct bead-beating 4x for 30s at 4 m/s.

steps.title: Pellet Sample and Mix Supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample and treat the supernatant with removal solutions.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min.
Mix the supernatant with 150 µl Inhibitor Removal Solution in a new collection tube.
Vortex briefly to mix.
Incubate at 2–8°C for 5 min.

steps.title: Add Lysis Solutions
steps.instruction: Mix the supernatant with specific kit solutions.

substeps.instruction: Mix the supernatant with 650 µl each of Solution PM3 and Solution PM4.

steps.title: Process through MB RNA Spin Column
steps.instruction: Purify the solution using the spin column.

substeps.instruction: Process the solution through MB RNA Spin Column by centrifugation (13,000 x g for 1 min).
Discard flow-through and repeat until all the solution has been processed.
Discard flow-through.
Add 650 µl Solution PM4.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min.
Discard flow-through.
Shake solution PM5.
Add 650 µl Solution PM5 to the Spin Column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min.

steps.title: Perform Final Wash and Dry
steps.instruction: Clean the column and remove residual wash.

substeps.instruction: Discard flow-through.
Add 650 µl Solution PM5.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min to remove residual wash.
Incubate spin columns with DNase Digestion Solution for 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Final Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Perform final cleanup of the column.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µl Solution PM7.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 min.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 2 min to dry.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the RNA into 1.5 ml eppendorf tubes.

substeps.instruction: Pass 50 uL of DEPC water through the column twice.
Centrifuge each elution at 13,000 x g for 1 min.
